1 · Intro

When to use it.

When an employee applies for and gets a job through a requisition, the transfer or promotion flows from recruiting. Central HR processes it, not the HCM.

Use this whenAn employee accepted a job they applied for through recruiting.

2 · Walk through

How it works.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Don't submit these transfers yourself, and never create a direct hire for someone already in process.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood experience for the Transfer process (24A) (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Who submits a transfer that came from a requisition?

Q2Someone's start is days away and you can't find them. What do you do?

Q3Why are these transfers centralized?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.
